meta.note: Agent-ready task queue. Each task is self-contained: inputs, outputs, acceptance criteria. Workstreams: GROUND (literature), FORMALIZE (definitions), PROVE, EXTEND (experiments/data), CONNECT (bridge writing), INFRA. status: open | in_progress | done | blocked. Update status and append to 'log' when working a task. depends_on lists task ids that must be done first; a task may not outrank a task it depends on.

tasks.acceptance: The schema validates every node and edge type in the plan; the cyclic world runs with N agents and unit tests from outline S4 and S18; one notation table maps every symbol (Omega, G, D, theta, delta, N_e, v, c, phi, r, lambda, L, and the new ones) to its definition and first use with no clashes; the primitive ledger lists the four proposed primitives.

tasks.title: Build the phenomena menu blind to the formalism
inputs: field surveys and textbooks via Semantic Scholar / arXiv
outputs: program/data/phenomena.json: at least 10 phenomena and 2 negative controls per field, added with provenance.blind = true
tasks.acceptance: The builder agent never sees spine.md, GM or claims.json; each entry has a bib key (added to bibliography.json and Librarian-checked) or a source hint; robust/replicated strength is supported by a checked review or meta-analysis; validate.py passes. Includes phenomena hostile to the program (e.g. poverty of the stimulus, content biases). Fields include conversation analysis, psycholinguistics and child language acquisition, grounded cognition, orality and literacy, and genre theory, with non-phenomena for speech acts.

tasks.title: Assess rival formalisms on the same menu
outputs: One assessment per phenomenon per rival formalism
tasks.acceptance: Each rival is assessed by an agent instructed to argue for that rival, with the same verdict rules as the spine; the scoreboard reports the spine's score relative to each rival.

tasks.title: Re-assess seed verdicts and demonstrate emergence
outputs: Reviewed assessments with tiers; emergence demonstrations under program/proofs or program/experiments
tasks.acceptance: Every must_emerge item either has a derivation at V3 or above, or a toy-model run in which the behavior appears without being coded in (with a code audit showing that), or is reclassified. Premise audit: each derivation's premises are core axioms or verified claims. The P-030/P-031 pair comes from one mechanism with only the frame varied.

tasks.title: Clear the protocol debt
outputs: checked sources for the listed phenomena, or a downgraded strength with a log note
tasks.acceptance: db.DEBT is empty and validate.py passes
